summary: PLAT-102: renamed billingUrl to billingEndpoint in libs/shared-contracts (bumped to 2.0.0) and in core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports; shipped as one PR (#1, merged 73fe85f) because CI builds every app against the contract and splitting would break CI. CI and CD succeeded. Assumptions: shared-contracts is in-repo and inlined (CONTRIBUTING), so no registry publish or dependency bump is needed; the 'release' is the apps redeploying. Sub-tasks 2-4 were satisfied by the same PR and the same CD run, not separate PRs. shellConfig key billingEndpointHint kept as is. Reports is deployed by CD even though docs/ci-cd.md does not mention it.
